_comment: The settings, in the order the menu shows them, read by the web (src/ui/settingsTable.ts) and Godot (SettingsSheet). Each row: id, section, name, a one-line hint, its control (toggle, slider, select or button), and for sliders min/max/step, for selects options (or none: the view fills them in). `only` keeps a row to one of the two (web or godot); `when` shows it only where it applies (installedAndroid: the app installed on Android). Defaults for the plain settings; graphics take theirs from the preset.
